description: Compare two semantic versions (1.2.3, pre-releases like 2.0.0-rc.1 handled by the SemVer rules) and get which is newer, plus the next major, minor and patch versions of the first. Use to decide whether an upgrade is a major change. Example: a=1.10.0, b=1.9.3. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: semver
